item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Tinubu’s core macroeconomic posts. finance, CBN, budget, tax, or the central coordination bodies, were handed to family members, business partners, or obvious ideological yes-men. The strongest negative evidence was in the housing/development layer, not the main macro team.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Establishes Comprehensive Economic Coordination and Planning System for Nigeria","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-03-27","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/","summary":"Tinubu created the PECC and EET, placed the finance minister and CBN governor at the center, and added economists and major private-sector figures. He also ordered rapid implementation of an emergency economic plan, which is strong evidence of empowering technocrats rather than only loyalists.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Concludes Post Financing Assessment with Nigeria","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-02-09","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/02/09/pr2443-nigeria-imf-exec-board-concludes-pfa","summary":"IMF said Tinubu moved ahead with subsidy removal and FX unification, created a fiscal/tax reform committee, and used palliatives such as cereals, fertilizer, wage awards, and diesel VAT suspension to soften the shock. This supports a reform-minded, expert-led approach rather than simple short-term populism.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Supporting Nigeria’s Homegrown Reforms: New World Bank Financing for Inclusive Growth and Revenue Diversification","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-06-13","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/13/supporting-nigeria-homegrown-reforms-new-world-bank-financing-for-inclusive-growth-and-revenue-diversification","summary":"The World Bank said the reform package was aimed at raising non-oil revenue, safeguarding oil revenue, and creating fiscal space for quality public services while also supporting 15 million vulnerable households. That is strong external validation of a sustainable-prosperity policy path.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints New Director-General of the Bureau of Public Enterprises","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-06-15","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-director-general-of-the-bureau-of-public-enterprises/","summary":"The appointee is described as a financial expert and chartered accountant with extensive experience, and the presidency said it expected him to advance fiduciary discipline and private-sector-driven reform. This is direct technocratic staffing in an economic agency.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints Management Team of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-04-05","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-management-team-of-the-nigerian-education-loan-fund/","summary":"Tinubu appointed a management team described as qualified Nigerians to stand up NELFUND for students and families nationwide. This is another technocratic appointment supporting long-horizon social investment rather than patronage.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints New Board of Family Homes Fund","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-07-02","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-board-of-family-homes-fund/","summary":"The presidency explicitly described the board members as qualified Nigerians expected to deploy expertise to grow the real estate sector. This is positive evidence for merit-based staffing in a housing-related development institution.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria’s Tinubu names seven ministers, sacks five in cabinet reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-23","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-sacks-five-in-cabinet-reshuffle/2325625/","summary":"In the reshuffle, Tinubu kept finance, national planning, defence, and two junior energy ministers in place while moving less central portfolios. That looks more like performance management and continuity at the economic core than a patronage purge or loyalty test.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: I have no Cabal or Sponsors to Compensate","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-07-26","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/","summary":"Tinubu publicly denied owing a cabal or sponsors and framed his reform choices as serving broad public welfare. This is rhetoric, not proof, but it cuts against a simple loyalty-repayment narrative.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Oyetunde Oladimeji Ojo: Nigeria's President Tinubu picks son-in-law to run housing agency","publisher":"BBC News","date":"2024-02-16","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2104503.html","summary":"Tinubu appointed his son-in-law to head the Federal Housing Authority, a direct family appointment in an economically relevant agency. This is the clearest counterexample to a purely technocratic pattern.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu violated oath of office by appointing son-in-law, says HURIWA","publisher":"The Guardian Nigeria","date":"2024-02-19","url":"https://guardian.ng/news/tinubu-violated-oath-of-office-by-appointing-son-in-law-says-huriwa/","summary":"A rights group alleged the son-in-law appointment reflected nepotism and a wider concentration of strategic appointments among kin. This is advocacy-level criticism rather than independent verification, but it corroborates the patronage concern.","question_ids":["5B.2"]}]}
